labelled_by: Claude, by viewing out/global/top8_<preset>.jpg and filmstrips of the tracklets (frames, boxes, trails); 1 = a human would accept it as that motion, 0 = no.

notes.u_turn: 1-4,6: factory workers walk in, turn round and walk back (worker_zone_detection, filmstrips/cards viewed, a real hairpin). 5,7: head/body sway of a standing person in face_demographics (path goes right and back, small): NOT a U-turn. 8: cartoon character sway.
notes.left_to_right: all eight move left to right in a straight line (arrow right, viewed): yonge_dundas pedestrians/cyclists, rochester_night cars.
notes.stop_and_go: 1: yonge pedestrian walks, stands ~3 s, walks on. 2: face_demographics woman walks in, pauses, steps aside. 3: cartoon. 4: one halt only. 5-8: continuous motion (filmstrips viewed), no halt.
notes.loiter: 1,3,7: person approaches and then stays in the same spot for 7-15 s (face_demographics). 2: cartoon character stays put. 4,6: cars driving across (wrong). 5,8: retail customers staying in a small area at the counter for 26-44 s.
notes.diagonal: heading 14-30 degrees (the sketch itself is 25 degrees in pixel geometry) and straight (>0.85); all eight cross the frame obliquely.

calibration.how: chosen by eye on these 40 labelled results (same sample the precision is measured on, so the verdict thresholds are optimistic)
